bound_or_value.quantity: maximum corrected load in complete lot Reed

satisfied_premises: The complete lot consists of T and U.
Corrected load equals recorded load minus assigned profile bias.
E2 supplies exact loads and biases for Reed / 2031-08-23 / glims.
E3 and E4 agree that T uses violet and U uses ivory; at least one is correct, establishing that assignment.
T has corrected load 12 − 10 = 2 glims; U has corrected load 20 − 3 = 17 glims.
rationale: The equal-authority assignment records agree. Because at least one is correct, their shared assignment holds in every compatible state without requiring either record individually to have priority or an independent truth guarantee. U's corrected load is 17 glims, exceeding the 11-glim acceptance limit. Acceptance therefore fails in every compatible state, so the complete lot must be held.
